summary_en: Nitto Denko will cancel 15,472,050 treasury shares on October 20, 2026, representing 2.28% of issued shares before cancellation. The cancellation follows the company's acquisition of treasury shares from April to August 2026 and aligns with its policy to retain shares for specific purposes such as executive compensation while canceling excess holdings.
title_en: Notice Regarding Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On September 30, 2026, Nitto Denko's board of directors resolved to cancel 15,472,050 treasury shares, representing 2.28% of issued shares before cancellation. The cancellation is scheduled to take effect on October 20, 2026, and will reduce issued shares from the current total to 663,187,650 shares.

The company acquired these treasury shares through purchases conducted from April to August 2026 under Article 165 of the Companies Act. Following the increase in treasury stock holdings, the company is proceeding with cancellation based on its treasury stock policy, which provides for retaining shares for specific, clearly defined purposes—primarily executive compensation—while canceling the excess portion.
